setting: a purpose-made illustrated instructional display, separate from the reviewed image-bank presentation and practice, with four equal unmarked display spaces
initial_state_or_goal: One illustrated cup, one illustrated plate, one illustrated spoon, and one illustrated bowl begin together in a loose cluster beside four equal empty, unmarked display spaces. All four object kinds are fully visible and visually distinct; no owner, food, material, color category, location meaning, or matching silhouette is established.
meaningful_development: Across one connected visual sequence, an anonymous hand briefly enters to lift the four illustrated objects one at a time from the cluster and place them into separate equal display spaces. Each moved object remains visibly the same object kind, and its bare label—cup, plate, spoon, or bowl—is locally presented; the changing arrangement makes the sequence develop without making the hand a participant or making placement, order, or matching a scored claim.
resolution_or_stopping_state: The anonymous hand is gone, the loose cluster is empty, and the illustrated cup, plate, spoon, and bowl are all simultaneously visible as four distinct ordinary object kinds in the completed four-space arrangement. The event stops at this visually complete distinction; nothing about containment, position, ownership, food, material, color, or silhouette matching is concluded.
